name: TARAXACUM OFFICINALE
key_symptoms: Sensation of great heat on top of head. Sterno-mastoid muscle very painful to touch.
Very restless limbs. Neuralgia of knee; better, pressure. Limbs painful to touch.
guiding_symptoms: Sensation of great heat on top of head. Sterno-mastoid muscle very painful to touch.
Very restless limbs. Neuralgia of knee; better, pressure. Limbs painful to touch.
head_symptoms: Sensation of great heat on top of head. Sterno-mastoid muscle very painful to touch.
gi_symptoms: Liver enlarged and indurated. Sharp stitches in left side. Sensation of bubbles bursting in bowels. Tympanites. Evacuation difficult.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Very restless limbs. Neuralgia of knee; better, pressure. Limbs painful to touch.
fever_symptoms: Chilliness after eating, worse drinking; finger tips cold. Bitter taste. Heat without thirst, in face, in toes. Sweat on falling asleep.

source.title: TARAXACUM OFFICINALE - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
